what: Before/after identity of every file the renderer writes, for the layered-architecture change. Before: main at 13c1ba5 (0.5.1). After: branch arch/engine-architecture-20261004. Hashes from scripts/identity_matrix.py; only the GPU certificate's timing_ms and the gpu_receipt fields derived from it are normalized.

comparisons.build: Windows, MSVC, default build (no GPU backend)
After: Windows MSVC against Linux GCC
D3D12 on WARP (software), debug layer on after
WebGPU on RTX 4090 (Chrome 154, ANGLE D3D11 flag, Dawn picks its backend)

verdicts_after.webgpu_swiftshader: 10 of 10 verified, identity DRIFT (same as before)
verdicts_after.d3d12_rtx4090: 10 of 10 verified; identity MATCH 7, DRIFT 3 (same bytes as before)
verdicts_after.webgpu_rtx4090: 10 of 10 verified; identity MATCH 7, DRIFT 3 (same bytes as before)
verdicts_after.d3d12_rtx4090_debug_layer: 4 quick cases, exit 0, no debug-layer errors
verdicts_after.wasm_default_render: 12 of 12 files identical before and after, and equal to native

finding: arena_certificate.json differs between MSVC and libstdc++ (55 vs 43 allocations for the default render). It did before this change too and was never in the cross-platform identity claim.
does_not_prove: Identity on the cases in scripts/identity_matrix.py only; other parameters were not rendered.
GPU identity holds for the named adapters and drivers only.
The 4090 WebGPU run used whichever Dawn backend Chrome chose; it is not recorded beyond the adapter info.
